name: prepare_feedback_materials
description: Prepare COMMENT and DANMAKU selected by the frozen current task. Host freezes a shared snapshot, processes sources concurrently, filters and deduplicates, jointly clusters vectors, and selects a small ranked representative package. Does not require video evidence and does not call a generative LLM. Returns materials_id and statistics only, never all originals. PENDING is durably resumed by host; do not poll. READY means materials prepared, not report generated.
